tasks.label: Capture local model decision output
tasks.command: cmd.exe /c "node -e \"const {loadEvents}=require('./server');const {createAIService}=require('./ai-service');const events=loadEvents();const event=events.find(e=>e.scenario&&e.scenario.supportedActions&&e.scenario.supportedActions.length)||events[0];const fetchImpl=async(url,options)=>{const response=await fetch(url,options);if(url.endsWith('/api/chat'))console.log('OLLAMA_RAW_RESPONSE',JSON.stringify((await response.clone().json()).message?.content));return response};const ai=createAIService({events,fetchImpl});ai.decision({eventId:event.id,date:event.date||String(event.year||'1900'),order:'Please negotiate a public agreement and open talks.',state:{stability:50,trust:50,liberties:50,legitimacy:50}}).then(x=>console.log('DECISION_OK',JSON.stringify(x))).catch(e=>{console.log('DECISION_ERROR',e.code,e.message);process.exitCode=1});\""

tasks.label: Inspect live decision output
tasks.command: cmd.exe /c "node -e \"const {loadEvents}=require('./server');const {createAIService}=require('./ai-service');const events=loadEvents();const event=events.find(e=>e.id==='emergency');const fetchImpl=async(u,o)=>{const r=await fetch(u,o);if(u.endsWith('/api/chat')){const j=await r.clone().json();console.log('RAW_CONTENT',j.message.content)}return r};const ai=createAIService({events,fetchImpl});ai.decision({eventId:'emergency',date:'25 June 1975',role:'India',state:{stability:55,trust:48,liberties:52,legitimacy:50},order:'Please negotiate a public agreement and open talks.'}).then(x=>console.log('OK',JSON.stringify(x))).catch(e=>console.log('ERROR',e.code,e.message));\""

tasks.label: Identify validator rejection condition
tasks.command: cmd.exe /c "node -e \"const C=require('./universal-scenarios'),{loadEvents}=require('./server');const e=loadEvents().find(x=>x.id==='emergency'),allowed=C.build(e).supportedActions,p={summary:'Open dialogue and negotiation',intention:'speculative',actionText:'Open dialogue and negotiation',requirements:['Open dialogue and negotiation'],risks:[],possibleConsequences:['Strengthen protections and oversight','Increase executive control'],clarificationQuestions:[]},keys=['summary','intention','actionText','requirements','risks','possibleConsequences','clarificationQuestions'];const validList=v=>Array.isArray(v)&&v.length<=5&&v.every(x=>typeof x==='string'&&x.trim().length>0&&x.length<=500);console.log(JSON.stringify({allowed,exactKeys:Object.keys(p).length===keys.length&&keys.every(k=>Object.hasOwn(p,k)),summary:!!p.summary.trim(),intention:!!p.intention.trim(),actionAllowed:allowed.includes(p.actionText),lists:[p.requirements,p.risks,p.possibleConsequences,p.clarificationQuestions].map(validList)}));\""

tasks.label: Trace decision validation branch
tasks.command: cmd.exe /c "node -e \"const E=require('./engine');const original=E.interpretAction;E.interpretAction=(...args)=>{const result=original(...args);console.log('ENGINE_INTERPRET',JSON.stringify({text:args[0],context:args[1],result}));return result};const {loadEvents}=require('./server');const {createAIService}=require('./ai-service');const events=loadEvents();const event=events.find(e=>e.id==='emergency');const ai=createAIService({events,fetchImpl:async(u,o)=>{const r=await fetch(u,o);if(u.endsWith('/api/chat'))console.log('MODEL',JSON.stringify((await r.clone().json()).message.content));return r}});ai.decision({eventId:'emergency',date:'25 June 1975',role:'India',state:{stability:55,trust:48,liberties:52,legitimacy:50},order:'Please negotiate a public agreement and open talks.'}).then(v=>console.log('RESULT',JSON.stringify(v))).catch(e=>console.log('FAILED',e.code,e.message));\""

tasks.label: Verify repaired live model decision
tasks.command: cmd.exe /c "node -e \"const {loadEvents}=require('./server');const {createAIService}=require('./ai-service');const events=loadEvents();const ai=createAIService({events});ai.decision({eventId:'emergency',date:'25 June 1975',role:'India',state:{stability:55,trust:48,liberties:52,legitimacy:50},order:'Please negotiate a public agreement and open talks.'}).then(x=>console.log(JSON.stringify({summary:x.summary,interpretation:x.interpretation,actions:x.actions,engineAction:x.engineAction,hasEffects:!!x.effects,warning:x.warning}))).catch(e=>{console.error(e.code,e.message);process.exitCode=1});\""
